BiblicalUsage: The nations Asnappar settled are set in the cities of Samaria, and the letter complains that the Jews are building the rebellious and the bad city. The word is the city itself, in the Aramaic of the empire's paperwork.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the city the letter calls rebellious and bad is Jerusalem, and the enemies' description is the compliment they did not mean.
